claimText: India's Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed on the Moon's south pole region in August 2023

brave.title: Chandrayaan-3: India becomes fourth country to land on the Moon
brave.description: ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully soft-landed on the lunar south pole region on August 23, 2023, making India the fourth country to land on the Moon.

brave.title: India's Chandrayaan-3 lands on Moon's south pole — a historic first
brave.description: India has made history by landing a spacecraft near the Moon's south pole, a feat no other country has accomplished. The Vikram lander touched down on August 23, 2023.

brave.title: NASA congratulates ISRO on successful Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing
brave.description: NASA Administrator Bill Nelson congratulated ISRO on the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023.

brave.title: Reuters: India's Moon mission Chandrayaan-3 successfully lands
brave.description: India's Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft successfully landed on the Moon's south pole region on Wednesday, making India the first country to land near the lunar south pole.
